vibe_rationale: Genuine independent music and camping culture, but at 123,500 visitors across four days with heavy sponsorship it leans mass-market, well beyond SURPLUS-style curation.
fit_notes: Adult, outdoor-minded music audience with strong hiking, camping and mountain adjacency, and non-endemic partners already in (Amazon, Coleman, Columbia, Heineken). Only a niche sampling or stall role fits at this cost, and no partnership contact is published.
